scope: Fresh bounded provenance/lane review and separated resume policy verification; no app edits or remote writes

findings.title: Returning to a retained older Spotify queue can assign replacement-deck reason to the old occurrence
findings.preconditions: Track T played from station playlist old deck with fresh reason; Spotify retains its order across published replacement deck that gives T favorite reason. Another context is observed before returning to the retained playlist.
reproduction: onboarded 200 tracks / 180000 ms; hub.play station; advance 10000 ms and forced real Hub sync
Capture Spotify player order/progress/context of old T (fresh). Publish replacement through actual saveDeck with newer writtenAt and T favorite.
Observe a different Spotify context for 10000 ms. Restore retained old Spotify playlist player/order and observe T for 10000 ms.
Advance 160000 ms and sync; read actual durable history SongFacts kind.
findings.expected: Old fresh occurrence must retain supported old reason or null; current replacement favorite is not evidence of which loaded deck produced the play.
findings.actual: T00000000000000000001c oldKind fresh, newKind favorite, stored actual favorite. New noteLane replaces reconciled-null note after context detour.
findings.cause: deck.writtenAt <= shown.at proves only publication before the previous observation, not that Spotify loaded the new deck. The latest observation can return to an older retained queue.
findings.repair_direction: Only recreate a positive lane when the loaded deck provenance is established; retain conservative uncertainty across deck disagreement and context detour without inferring refresh from timestamp.
required_checks: retained old queue after changed-reason replacement, external detour and return
replacement with absent or multiple T reasons must remain null
positive normal new-deck start and unchanged-reason continuity
guest/native isolation and no extra Spotify requests
